case.summary: The alert was triggered by an autonomous monitor detecting 15 online authorizations under $5 within an hour on card C06744-K2, specifically flagging transaction 3541294 for $0.92. Graph evidence showed the transaction model scored the flagged event at 0.049 and a related $0.79 transaction 0.6 hours earlier at 0.76, while the generic device profile had been seen 14 times prior on this card. During step-up authentication, the cardholder denied making the transactions, confirming card-not-present fraud. The final decision was to close the case as fraud, block the card, and create a case.
